records.query: Design a rate limiting system for an API.
records.plan: 1) Identify endpoints and limits per user and per IP. 2) Choose algorithm (token bucket) and data store (Redis). 3) Implement middleware with headers and backoff. 4) Add monitoring and alerts. 5) Load test and tune limits.

records.query: Plan a database migration with zero downtime.
records.plan: 1) Add new schema side by side. 2) Backfill data in batches with validation. 3) Dual write from the app. 4) Cut over reads with feature flags. 5) Monitor and keep rollback path. 6) Remove old schema after stability.

records.query: Troubleshoot a memory leak in a Python service.
records.plan: 1) Reproduce under load. 2) Capture memory profiles over time. 3) Compare heap snapshots to find growing objects. 4) Audit caches and global references. 5) Add limits and fix leaks. 6) Verify with soak tests.

records.query: Troubleshoot a memory leak in a Python service.
records.plan: 1) Restart the service. 2) Add more memory. 3) Hope it is fine.

records.query: Troubleshoot a memory leak in a Python service.
records.plan: Check logs and try random changes until it stops.

records.query: Design a secure password reset flow.
records.plan: 1) Generate single use token with short TTL. 2) Send link via verified email. 3) Rate limit requests and add CAPTCHA. 4) Validate token and enforce strong password rules. 5) Invalidate sessions and log event.

records.query: Design a secure password reset flow.
records.plan: 1) Send a reset link. 2) User changes password. 3) Done.
